_readme: Named probe suites for `python3 scripts/run_probes.py` (see scripts/probe_cache.py).
Patterns are globs relative to THIS directory; a positional argument that is not a
file and not a glob is treated as a suite name, so `run_probes.py live` works.
A probe is only run when it can be pointed at the base URL: probes declaring
`--base` get it as an argument, probes reading A11Y_BASE/SITE_BASE get it in the
environment, and anything else is SKIPPED with a printed reason (it cannot be
aimed at the deployed build, so it must not be reported as verified against it).
Add a suite when a wave wants a stable name for a subset, e.g.
Every run is cached per commit + deployed stack, so re-running a suite that has
already passed against the same build short-circuits with the stored evidence.
